metadata.name: Dead Sea Scrolls: Unrolled
metadata.description:
[h1]Dead Sea Scrolls: Unrolled[/h1] Dead Sea Scrolls (DSS) is the menu many big mods use — Fiend Folio, Epiphany, IPECAC, Heaven's Call, Encyclopedia, Alt Horsemen and others. This mod unrolls it into a wide parchment scroll.
[h2]What changes[/h2] [list] [*][b]A grid of hand-drawn icons with captions[/b] instead of a long text list — pages flip left and right. [*][b]One window for all mods[/b]: every installed mod that has a DSS menu, a Mod Config Menu section or Passive Skill Trees is a tile with the mod's Workshop picture; open any of them from one place. [*]Settings, changelogs and pages of every DSS mod work as before — only the look changes. [*]The scroll title, the tip panel and all menu text follow the game language (English or Russian). Russian letters in DSS use the Cyrillic font from Mod Translator; without it the menu stays in English. [/list]
[h2]Requirements[/h2] [list] [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3127536138]REPENTOGON[/url] [*]any mod with a Dead Sea Scrolls menu (otherwise there is nothing to show) [/list] Only mods you actually have installed are shown in the window.
[h2]Links[/h2] Source code: [url=https://github.com/blackhellvelz-prog/isaac-dss-unrolled]GitHub[/url] More from the same set: Basement Scrapbook Menu, Talents for Everyone, Peat, Isaac-Style, Mod Fixes & Speedups, Russian Translation for Mods.
Pictures of popular mods are used in the Mods menu and the DSS window — thanks to their creators and the Isaac modding community!
Made with Universal Modder. Dead Sea Scrolls is made by the DSS team (Fiend Folio); this mod only redraws its menu at runtime and does not change its files. Author: blackhellvelz.
